name: LightPlan
subtitle: Plan around the light
promotional_text: Mark a subject on the map, see when the Sun or Moon aligns with it, and search the next 14 days for the shot.
description: See sunrise, sunset, golden and blue-hour windows in your destination’s time zone. Explore directions on a map, save shoot plans and choose reminders. Astronomical calculations work offline for known coordinates and time zones; maps and search may need a connection. Try today’s basic information, then unlock the complete planning tools with a one-time purchase. No subscription and no account required. Times are estimates: clouds, buildings and terrain can change what you see. Tap a photographic subject on the map to compare its bearing with the Sun or Moon. The full unlock adds 14-day alignment search and geometric shooting-position suggestions.
screenshot_captions: Choose a place and date, explore sun and moon directions, and prepare your next photo session.
